summary: Faraday Future Intelligent Electric Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a 1-for-150 reverse stock split, effective July 24, 2026. The amendment was authorized by stockholders on May 22, 2026. No fractional shares were issued; proportionate adjustments were made to the company's equity plans, warrants, convertible securities, and preferred stock. This filing is a routine corporate action to maintain Nasdaq listing compliance (or boost per-share price), not a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. Therefore, it does not fit any special-situations category. No deal terms are applicable.
